name: Sange
source:
A brother and sister live alone in a remote area.
The sister, who has precognitive abilities, sees the future at the cost of her own life.
The brother asks, "Will you be in my future, sister?"

[Translated from Melonbooks.com]
translation:
一对兄妹独自住在偏远地区。妹妹拥有预知能力，但每次看见未来都要以自己的生命为代价。

哥哥问道：“姐姐，你会在我的未来里吗？”[译自Melonbooks.com]
